title: PMP Plan: Mid-February 2027
lead: Sit the PMP between Feb 16 and 19, 2027. The travel months carry the 35-hour course and the application at 4 to 5 hours a week; January and early February carry practice exams at 8 to 10 hours a week.

weeks.tasks: Join PMI. Buy a self-paced 35-hour course. Download the 2026 Exam Content Outline. Check your UC transcript for project management coursework.
Worksheet: list every candidate project with start and end months.
Pick projects that cover 36+ non-overlapping months. Name a verifier for each.
Give each verifier a heads-up. Confirm they can sign in December or January if you are audited.
Draft role summary 1.
Draft role summary 2.
Draft the remaining role summaries.
Thanksgiving week: course only.
Edit the summaries. Start the PMI online application and enter your projects.
Finish the course and save the completion certificate. Submit the application by Fri Dec 11.
PMI review, about 5 business days. If approved: pay the member exam fee and book Feb 16 to 19. If audited: send the audit package this week. Skim the ECO tasks.
Holiday buffer: catch up on anything that slipped, or rest.
Holiday buffer.
Full-length timed practice exam (240 minutes) as a baseline. Review every miss.
Business Environment (26% of the exam): practice sets and review.
People (33%): practice sets, agile and hybrid scenarios.
Process (41%): practice sets, case-study items.
Full-length practice exam 2. Drill your weakest domain.
Full-length practice exam 3 by Wed Feb 10, then review. Check exam logistics: ID, test center route or online system check.
Light review only. Exam day Feb 16 to 19.

weeksNote: Total: about 100 hours. Course hours are hours of content finished; at 1.25x playback the course takes about 28 hours of your time.

deadlines.why: An audit needs a signed verification from a supervisor or sponsor for each project. Holiday travel slows signatures.
The application cannot be submitted without completed hours.
Review takes about 5 business days. An audit adds however long the signatures take.
Payment opens a one-year window. Booking early locks a Feb 16 to 19 slot.
Leaves days to review misses before the real exam.
Feb 16 to 19 is the target; one week of slip keeps you in February.

deadlineNotes.text: Set up your PMI account with your name exactly as it appears on the ID you will bring to the exam.
The December 1 training rule only affects live classes from providers that are not PMI-authorized. A self-paced course is unaffected.

worksheet.intro: List projects whose combined, non-overlapping months reach 36 or more within the past 10 years. Submitting in December 2026 means experience back to December 2016 counts.

rules.text: Each entry on the current form asks for organization, job title, start and end dates, and a role summary of 100 to 500 words.
Dates are the period you led that project, not your full time at the company.
Overlapping months count once. Where periods overlap, report the longest project.
The job title does not need to say Project Manager. The summary must show you led the work.

template.intro: Aim for 200 to 350 words per entry. Cover three parts, in your own words, with numbers where you have them.

parts.title: Role
parts.body: As [job title] at [organization], I led [project] to [objective]. I was accountable for [scope, schedule, budget, team size, key stakeholders].

parts.title: Contributions
parts.body:
What you personally led across the exam's three domains.
People: how you directed the team and managed stakeholders and conflicts.
Process: how you planned, tracked and controlled scope, schedule, risk, changes and quality.
Business environment: how you kept the work tied to business goals, value and compliance.

parts.title: Outcomes
parts.body: What the project delivered, whether it met scope, schedule and budget, and the measurable benefit to the client or organization. For an ongoing project, results so far.

template.closing: Every claim should be one your verifier would sign as written.

audit.intro: Audits are random. PMI allows 90 days to respond, but sending the package within a week keeps February intact. Have these ready before you submit.

items.text: Copy of your degree (bachelor's or higher)
Signed experience verification from a supervisor or sponsor for each project listed
Current contact details for every verifier, including where they will be in December
